root_cause: A simulated bad deployment activates FAULT_ERROR_RATE=0.5 on order-service, causing 50% of non-health requests to return HTTP 500. A deploy event is timestamped in data/deploy_events.jsonl immediately before the error spike, allowing what_changed to link the deploy to the degradation
expected_fix: Roll back the deployment by clearing the fault: POST /admin/fault with {"error_rate": 0}. In production: use blue-green deployments or canary releases with automated error-rate gates (e.g. reject if error rate > 1% within 5 minutes of deploy)
